in_arabic.name: Qindilah
in_arabic.long_meaning: Qindilah هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. The name Qindilah is of Arabic origin, derived from the words qndl, meaning 'moon' and ilah, meaning 'god'. Thus, the name Qindilah means 'goddess of the moon' or 'moon goddess'. This name carries a deep spiritual significance, representing the divine feminine and the cycle of life and the moon.
